regime_details.scope: Observed event counts do not determine whether recurrence is scientifically possible. Competing absorbing causes are described only when terminal_cause was explicitly declared and multiple causes occur. These labels do not select a likelihood, event-eligibility rule or causal model.

observation_process_details.scope: Exact/coarsened is an analyst declaration, not a verified MAR/CAR/MNAR assumption. An observed zero, an unmonitored interval, a between-row gap and delayed entry are distinct. Delayed entry is tagged here; fit and prediction interfaces retain their own supported-observation checks.

assumptions: static baseline binary treatment; consistency and no interference
conditional treatment exchangeability given declared baseline strata (not empirically testable)
positive treatment probabilities and conditionally independent right censoring with positive survival
independent subjects; sufficient retained count state; no simultaneous distinct jumps
correct event intensities OR correct treatment-probability times censor-survival product for consistency
EIF asymptotics require nuisance convergence, product-rate and targeting regularity conditions
finite-state/time-grid approximation must be assessed; no finite-sample coverage guarantee

numerical.scope: Numerical bounds and simulation errors are not sampling confidence intervals. Quadrature, time-grid, propagation, covariate Monte Carlo and parameter uncertainty remain distinct.
